+"""Interactive controller for the BEHAVIOR-1K limited-mode lunch-box episode.
+
+Run with: python -i /app/output/gen.py
+All actions are sent only through the rcb-limited client. This file deliberately
+does not issue motion on import; the operator chooses each next action after
+reviewing the latest camera images.
+"""
+import json, pathlib, sys, time
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+print("Connected", r.base, "remaining", r.status().get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+counter = 0
+
+def snap(tag="obs", seconds=0.0, video="frames"):
+    global counter
+    o = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
+    d = OUT / f"{counter:03d}_{tag}"
+    o.save(str(d))
+    counter += 1
+    print("snapshot", d, "status", {k:o.meta.get(k) for k in ("time_left_s","sim_time_s","done","reason")}, flush=True)
+    return o
+
+def run_jp(actions, dt=1/30, note=""):
+    global counter
+    a = np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32)
+    if a.ndim == 1: a = a[None,:]
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", a, dt=dt, video="mp4", note=note)
+    d = OUT / f"{counter:03d}_{note or 'joint'}"
+    res.save(str(d)); counter += 1
+    print("action", d, "rows",len(a), "meta", json.dumps(res.meta, default=str), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def run_ee(rows, note=""):
+    global counter
+    a = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+    if a.ndim == 1: a = a[None,:]
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", a, video="mp4", note=note)
+    d = OUT / f"{counter:03d}_{note or 'ee'}"
+    res.save(str(d)); counter += 1
+    print("action", d, "rows",len(a), "meta", json.dumps(res.meta, default=str), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def joints():
+    return np.array(r.get_obs(video="frames").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+def eefrow(left=None, right=None, left_g=None, right_g=None):
+    """Build one 16-value EE row from live EE poses; overrides are xyz or full xyz+quat."""
+    p = np.array(r.get_obs(video="frames").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    L = p[35:42].copy(); R = p[42:49].copy()
+    if left is not None: L[:len(left)] = left
+    if right is not None: R[:len(right)] = right
+    lg = 1.0 if left_g is None else left_g
+    rg = 1.0 if right_g is None else right_g
+    return np.r_[L,lg,R,rg].astype(np.float32)
+
+def state():
+    s = r.status()
+    o = r.get_obs(video="frames")
+    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"])
+    print("status", {k:s.get(k) for k in ("step","calls","control_steps","done","time_left_s")})
+    print("base",p[28:35].round(3).tolist(),"left_eef",p[35:42].round(3).tolist(),"right_eef",p[42:49].round(3).tolist())
+    return o
+
+print("Helpers: snap(tag), run_jp(actions,dt), run_ee(rows), eefrow(...), state()", flush=True)
*** End Patch";
